card.name: Sentence-ending marks before a new question
card.fires_on: Question marks and periods that end a sentence, plus small words like "you" or "to" after "what" or "do", mostly just before a new sentence or question begins in web articles.

modes.label: Question mark ending a heading question
modes.description: A question mark closing a rhetorical or study question, with another question following.
modes.example: What is the American Civil Liberties Union<<?>> What is their mission?

modes.label: Period before a new topic sentence
modes.description: A sentence-final period just before a new sentence that shifts or introduces the next point.
modes.example: Talk to your surgeon about your goals and expectations for this procedure<<. >>How is the procedure performed?

modes.label: Small word after what/do
modes.description: A word like "to" or "you" in a "what to do" style phrase.
modes.example: do not know what<< to>> do with it.

card.plain: It fires at the end of a sentence or question, just before the text moves on to the next one.
